answer: Follow the money after payout. A sybil farm exists to collect rewards, so sooner or later its many accounts sweep coins toward one wallet, like streams draining off a ridge into a single creek. Track where rewards flow; when dozens of accounts feed the same destination, merge them into one identity that earns one share and forfeits the rest. Rare spice like saffron is worth stealing only if it can be sold, and a jade carving is hard to fence once every buyer can trace it.
